meta.title: Consult with the Recipient line left empty bounces back
gaps: Log in to Asha's mailbox and open the Procol approval request email
Click Consult to create a new email with an Action:Consult subject
Enter a comment while leaving Recipient empty and send without changing the subject
Wait for Procol to process the mailbox message
Verify that no consultation is created in the approval workflow or buyer portal
